data.action: 端坐在复古花窗飘窗软垫上，膝上摊开羊皮纸诗集，轻抚书页，转头温柔微笑
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, poetic solitude
data.description: 【薇薇安娜 · 莱塔尼亚书斋的月下长诗】莱塔尼亚古老宏伟的皇家哥特图书馆内，高耸入云的胡桃木书架环绕四周。薇薇安娜身着深蓝天鹅绒蕾丝贵族礼裙，静静坐在雕花彩绘玻璃窗边的软垫长椅上，膝上摊开一本手抄诗集，月光如银纱般披拂在她金色的巨角与发丝上——「‘当烛火在长夜中熄灭，唯有诗篇在星尘中永生。’……博士，你也喜欢这首诗吗？」
data.lighting: 彩绘玻璃透入的静谧冷月光与黄铜台灯微光
data.location: 莱塔尼亚大图书馆月光花窗边
data.promptProse: On the cushioned window bench of the Leithanian royal library, Viviana keeps the handwritten poetry book open across her sapphire velvet gown and lightly touches the page, turning her head with a gentle smile. Retain the eye-level medium shot, black lace sleeves, antlers and hairpins. The carved bench edge recedes behind her toward a narrow aisle; tall walnut shelves alternate with darker gaps beyond it. Moonlight through the stained glass cools the outer curves of her antlers and hair. The existing brass lamp warms the parchment and fingers, with her hand casting a small soft shadow across the page and the shelf recesses remaining subdued.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 莱塔尼亚书斋的月下长诗
